name: ModelVariant761_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant761_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a half ring of light opens around the slot and grows in three widening passes while a spinning cone rises in its middle and a beam climbs upward and fades, tinting the parts during a window, dimming the ambient light until the burst and shaking the camera); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the beam, ring and cone points from the slot dimensions and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the delay, 1 until the burst time, 0 until the end time and 2 afterwards; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-778 and 875 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
